posts.author: maxdevige
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I fell in love with the map transition by Mikagami Atelier presented in
this thread
, which reminds me of FF6 and which I would absolutely like to implement in my game.
It's a "mosaic" transition, where the pixels on the screen slowly grow larger before shrinking to reveal the new screen.
I've seen that Hakuen Studio offers a version of a similar effect, but this one is rougher, faster and cuts to black at the end. In short, it hurts the eyes a little more. I'd really like to recapture the smoothness of Mikagami Atelier's version.
That's why I'm looking for someone willing to try and adapt
this script
into a working plugin for RPG Maker MZ.
Unfortunately, as my javascript skills are nil, I can't take on this project myself...
Thanks in advance for any help you can give me.
